A '[[Clone navigation officer/Legends|''clone naval officer''']] was stationed on a medical [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]], the ''[[Sanctuary III]]'', during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this clone along with at least four others were sent from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] to evacuate stabilized wounded [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] patients from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]], the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

This operation was time-sensitive due to the imminent arrival of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|Malevolence]], a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]. Armed with two giant [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] capable of wiping out entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], the heavy cruiser—under the command of the Confederate [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]]—was on its way to destroy the medical station from which the Sanctuary III and its sister ships were evacuating the wounded clones. This clone along with their ship completed their part of the mission and was gone from the facility before the arrival of the Malevolence, which was ultimately destroyed by Republic forces.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />
